profile_interpretation: DSP-adjacent synthetic evidence under the Room profile; no measured room acoustics, real recording or device claim

decision.basis: Finite output and near-end-only stability are established only on frozen synthetic fixtures; recorded room, double-talk, loop-gain, device and rights gates remain open.

public_boundary.registration: explicit caller-side as_register_provider_v0 only in the opt-in consumer test; no installed registry entry
public_boundary.sidechain: task-local rls_aec_feed_reference helper only; not an SDK API/ABI change

reference.zero_reference_guard: skip RLS update when reference energy <= epsilon
reference.finite_state_guard: restore finite state and freeze adaptation on nonfinite or boundedness violation
reference.gain_before_feedback: synthetic L1 residual-path loop-margin proxy, not measured loudspeaker loop gain

canonical_report.format: canonical JSON: sort_keys=True, compact separators, allow_nan=False, one trailing newline

invariants: Fixed v0 format only: 16 kHz, mono f32, 160 samples. Installed ABI, descriptors, registry, defaults and v0 behavior are unchanged.
The C provider is task-local and off by default. OFF leaves it unlinked and unregistered; ON requires explicit caller-side registration.
The render sidechain is explicit. With no supplied reference the provider and adapter pass the microphone through without adapting and report a blocked result.
Near-end-only zero-reference stability is demonstrated in-fixture by skipped RLS updates and a 160,000-sample extension that remains finite where the legacy recursion overflows.
Nonfinite or boundedness violations restore finite state and freeze adaptation before any sample is emitted; a safety freeze is never a qualifying result.

Far/near/mic mixture, convergence, delay change, double-talk preservation, delayed/misaligned/dropped reference, missing reference and adversarial near burst are all reported; no missing or invalid result qualifies a candidate.
ERLE/echo-return loss, near-end SNR, synthetic L1 gain-before-feedback proxy and fixed-attenuation controls are reported separately; double-talk preservation is a control, not a release gate.

All evidence is deterministic synthetic data. No measured room acoustics, real recording, model weights, downloads, licensed runtime, listening, real-speech MOS/STOI, target-device timing or release qualification is claimed.
Canonical reports and synthetic output digests are byte-identically reproducible from pinned sources.
release_gates: Paired licensed render/capture recordings with known loop timing, pinned RIRs/path measurements and held-out speech rights
Measured loudspeaker-loop gain-before-feedback and stability with device buffers, clock drift and target-device CPU/memory/deadline timing
Double-talk, path-change and nonlinear-loudspeaker evaluation with AECMOS/ASR/listening preservation and attenuation gates
Provider intake, license/rights, descriptor and public catalog review before any default, installed or production processor
